name: Green Pea Dal
ingredients: ½ cup (100 g) dried split green peas, soaked 4 hours
½ cup fresh or frozen green peas
Tadka: 1 tsp oil, ½ tsp cumin seeds, 2 garlic cloves, 1 green chilli, pinch of hing
steps: Pressure-cook the split peas with turmeric, tomato and 2 cups water for 4 whistles until soft.
Add the fresh peas and simmer for 5 minutes.
Heat the oil, crackle the cumin, and add garlic, chilli and hing until golden.
Pour the tadka into the dal and add garam masala.
Finish with lemon juice, salt and coriander.
note: Split peas give a thicker, creamier dal than most lentils.
